description: This is a Python source file implementing a module that runs Robot Framework tests in the background, handles artifact uploads to MinIO, and manages test run lifecycle including database updates. It includes functions for executing tests, parsing results, uploading artifacts, and updating run statuses, with extensive error handling and logging.

methods.name: None run_tests_background( run_id: str, minio_bytes: bytes, filename: str, variables: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None, tests: Optional[List[str]] = None, )
methods.description: Main function to run Robot Framework tests from bytes in a background thread, handle artifacts, and update database.

methods.name: None _mark_run_status(run_id: str, status: str)
methods.description: Updates the status of a test run in the database.

methods.name: str _write_robot_file(tmpdir: str, filename: str, content: bytes)
methods.description: Writes robot test content bytes to a temporary file and returns its path.

methods.name: Optional[List[str]] _prepare_variable_list(variables: Optional[Dict[str, str]])
methods.description: Converts a dictionary of variables into a list suitable for Robot Framework CLI.

methods.name: Tuple[str,str,str] _run_robot( robot_path: str, variable_list: Optional[List[str]], tests: Optional[List[str]], tmpdir: str, )
methods.description: Runs a Robot Framework suite using the provided robot file and parameters, returning paths to output, log, and report files.

methods.name: Dict[str,Optional[int]] _parse_results(output_path: str)
methods.description: Parses the Robot Framework output.xml into a summary dictionary.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] _upload_artifacts( run_id: str, output_path: str, log_path: str, report_path: str )
methods.description: Uploads output, log, and report files to MinIO storage.

methods.name: None _insert_test_results(run_id: str, output_path: str)
methods.description: Inserts individual test case results into the database.

methods.name: None _finalize_run(run_id: str, summary: Dict[str, Optional[int]], artifacts: Dict[str, str])
methods.description: Marks the run as complete in the database, including summary and artifacts.

methods.name: None _maybe_upload(file_path: str, key_suffix: str, content_type: str)
